in_sanskrit.name: श्रीलीला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The divine play of the Goddess

in_marathi.name: Sreeleela
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Music
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sreeleela हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sreeleela is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sree’ which means wealth or goddess and ‘Leela’ which means play or music. It is the name of the goddess Lakshmi who is often depicted playing the Veena. This name symbolizes the divine play of the goddess and her connection to music and art.
